title: Retry transient Docker Hub pull failures before building the artifacts example
answers: artifacts example integration test fails when Docker Hub times out pulling postgres
CI flaky failure docker compose pull auth timeout in test_mlflow_artifacts
how do I retry docker image pulls in the mlflow artifacts integration test
test_mlflow_artifacts_example fails on registry error instead of application error
body:
Symptom: The MLflow artifacts example CI job fails intermittently when Docker Hub's auth endpoint times out while pulling an image such as postgres, even though the example itself is fine.
Root cause: tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py:test_mlflow_artifacts_example runs ./build.sh and docker compose run with no pull step or retry, so one transient registry failure fails the whole test.
Fix pattern: Run `docker compose pull --ignore-buildable` in a bounded loop (3 attempts, sleeping 5s then 10s between them) before build.sh and docker compose run; break on success and echo a message and exit 1 after the final attempt.
Constraints: Only the pull is retried. Build and application failures must not be retried; the script uses `set -e` so they stop immediately. Keep any new retry inside the same generated shell script.
applies: Applies to the shell script embedded in tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py:test_mlflow_artifacts_example; not to other Docker-based tests unless they share this pattern.
says: Artifacts example integration test in continuous integration fails due to container registry timeout.
Automated build pipeline intermittently fails when downloading the postgres image from Docker Hub.
Retry container image pulls during example tests before failing the automated test job.
Distinguish transient container registry download errors from actual artifact build or application failures.
Pull request test suite fails on transient docker authentication timeouts rather than code bugs.

The test's embedded shell script executes docker compose pull --ignore-buildable in a 3-attempt bounded loop with 5s and 10s sleeps before running ./build.sh and docker compose run. Only the pull step is retried, while build and application failures stop immediately under set -e without retries.
